title: Ghost Tours return to dowtown Wausau
excerpt: The Wausau Paranormal Research Society will once again highlight some of the most haunted places in Wausau during its annual Ghost Tours this month.
content:
WAUSAU, Wis. (WSAW) - The Wausau Paranormal Research Society will once again highlight some of the most haunted places in Wausau during its annual Ghost Tours this month.

Traditional guided ghost tours are scheduled for Friday, October 16 and Friday, October 23 at 6 p.m., 7 p.m., and 8 p.m. These tours are led by a WPRS member. The walking tour takes you through downtown Wausau while learning about the documented paranormal activity at various locations.

Guided ghost tours with costumed characters will take place Saturday, October 17 and Saturday, October 24. Ticket sales begin at 4:30 p.m., with tours running every 30 minutes beginning at 5:30 p.m. The last tour begins at 7 p.m. These tours feature a walking tour of downtown Wausau, stopping along the way to visit with some of Wausau’s resident ghosts, who will share their haunted history.

All tours are $15 and begin and end at the Wausau Elk’s Club. Friday tour tickets reservations can be made at this link. Saturday tour tickets are cash only and sold in person at the Elk’s Club.
